title: Market Debut Sprint Scoreboard and Acceptance Gates
content:
OVERVIEW:
This is a compact sprint scoreboard and gate checklist intended for Product Ops to drive the Market Debut milestone (aka "market debut"). It blends a lightweight Gantt-style sprint timeline, a short KPI scoreboard with explicit formulas and thresholds, and a three-tier acceptance gate matrix (Feature, Performance, Compliance). Use this sheet during weekly cadence and the go/no-go meeting.

SPRINT SCOREBOARD (single-line lanes for quick scanning):
- Week 1 (Nov 18-24): final UI polish (owner: UX - Priya) | ticket PROJ-450 | status: blocked by API contract
- Week 2 (Nov 25-Dec 1): infra capacity tests + canary routing (owner: Infra - Luca) | PROJ-451 | status: on-track
- Week 3 (Dec 2-8): observability hooks + eskalation flows (owner: SRE - Owen) | status: on-track
- Week 4 (Dec 9-15): stakeholder rehearsals, runbooks, dry-run launch (owner: Product Ops) | status: in_review

KPI SCOREBOARD (definition | baseline | target | gate):
- End-to-end latency P95 (ms) | baseline: 420ms | target: <= 250ms | gate: must be <= 300ms on canary with realistic load
- User-perceived success rate (%) = (successful responses / total requests) * 100 | baseline: 98.1% | target: >= 99.5% | gate: >= 99.0% on canary
- Error budget burn rate (7d) | baseline: 3% | target: < 5% | gate: < 10%
- Token cost per 1k user tokens (USD) | baseline: $5.30 | target: <= $4.20 | gate: within 15% of target during soak
- Coverage of regression evals (critical prompt set) | baseline: 64 prompts | target: 120 prompts | gate: >= 100 prompts passing quality threshold

ACCEPTANCE GATES (Decision matrix):
- Feature Gate: All P0 and P1 product tickets must be resolved or have explicit mitigations (owner: Product Manager).
- Performance Gate: KPIs above must satisfy gate thresholds during a 48h canary with production-like traffic (owner: Infra + SRE).
- Compliance Gate: Data residency & KMS checks completed, audit trail for private data flows verified (owner: Security & Compliance).
Decision options per gate: GO / CONDITIONAL GO (with documented mitigation) / HOLD. Owners must sign-off in the weekly go/no-go doc.

PRE-LAUNCH CHECKLIST (top-risk items):
- Canary traffic split configured and tested (TASK: infra runbook, PROJ-451).
- Fallback model variant configured and automatic routing rule validated (owner: Serving Runtime).
- Rate limiting and quota tiers applied for pilot customers (owner: Product Ops).
- SLA & billing meter test: simulated heavy usage to validate cost metering (owner: Finance ops).
- Communication templates ready: status page, incident channel, customer success playbook.

ROLLBACK & TRIGGER RULES (explicit numeric thresholds):
- Trigger rollback if user-perceived success rate falls below 95% for >= 30 minutes OR P95 latency exceeds 800ms sustained for >= 10 minutes.
- Auto-fallback to compact model variant if token cost exceeds target by > 40% during the first 6h of pilot traffic.
- Manual rollback path documented: steps, runbooks, contact list (SRE lead, Infra lead, Product Ops lead).

COMMUNICATION PLAN:
- 15m pre-launch heads-up to execs + CS.
- Launch hour: live Slack channel (ops/market-debut), Zoom standby with infra & SRE.
- Post-launch: 1h, 6h, 24h check-ins; daily for first 3 days.

POST-LAUNCH MONITORING DASHBOARD (minimum tiles):
- Live request rate, P95 latency, success rate, error categories (5xx, 4xx), token spend burn-rate, canary vs global comparison.
- Alerting: PagerDuty for severity P0 (site outage) and P1 (sustained high errors).

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS (for triage):
- Is the regression eval set representative of enterprise workloads? (Action: Research add-on prompts; owner Research).
- Can Finance decouple meter shimmer effects in the first 72h to prevent false cost triggers? (Action: Finance ops to provide smoothing policy).

NOTES / LINKS:
- See runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MD/Runbooks
- Canary plan: PROJ-451
- Eval harness: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MD/Evals

SHORT INSTRUCTIONS FOR SCOREBOARD USAGE:
1) Update weekly lane statuses and next blockers before Friday sync.
2) Owners must paste 48h canary snapshots into the sheet for gate review.
3) If a gate is CONDITIONAL GO, attach the mitigation ticket and expected date to close.

This doc is intentionally concise — keep a separate long-form launch runbook for step-by-step ops instructions. Use this sheet for decisions, scorekeeping, and cross-functional visibility during the Market Debut sprint.
